classificationLegend.REQUIRES_INFRASTRUCTURE: external infrastructure absent; internal contract + adapter + unavailable-state behavior implemented and tested
classificationLegend.REQUIRES_AUTHORITY: external governance ratification absent; internal boundary implemented and fail-closed

dependencies.name: Vector / semantic retrieval infrastructure
dependencies.internalBoundary: src/lib/noelia/rag-provider.ts — KnowledgeRetrievalProvider contract; GovernedKeywordRetrievalProvider (active); VectorRetrievalProvider (declared, inactive, reports UNAVAILABLE)
dependencies.unavailableBehavior: retrieve() → { status: UNAVAILABLE, sources: [], reason }; never fabricates semantic results
activationRequirements: external vector index (pgvector or external vector database) provisioned and governed
embedding model ratified through the model gateway (Iteration 17) with data-egress authorization
ingestion pipeline that chunks, classifies, checksums and version-controls documents BEFORE indexing
tenant/entity/country + classification + authority + freshness filters pushed INTO the vector query (no post-hoc filtering of unauthorized content)

dependencies.name: External LLM / embedding model providers
dependencies.internalBoundary: src/lib/noelia/platform-services.ts — deterministic in-repo analyst (beyu-hive-deterministic-analyst); model/modelVersion/promptVersion recorded on every ai_decisions row
dependencies.unavailableBehavior: No external provider is invoked anywhere in the runtime; the deterministic analyst is the only active model path
activationRequirements: provider registered in a governed model registry with classification, jurisdiction, cost, latency and risk attributes (Iteration 17)
data-egress authorization for the specific classification levels
fallback to the deterministic analyst on provider failure
no data may leave the BEYU boundary unless the provider is authorized
